name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code, one folder each.

plugins.name: teams-tasks
plugins.description: Reads your recent Microsoft Teams conversations, works out what you need to do, and keeps those tasks in a panel beside the chat.

plugins.name: session-tracker
plugins.description: Shows every Claude session on this machine with the repository, worktree and branch it works in, and flags branches and worktrees that hold unpushed work or can be cleaned up.
